targets.pruned_description: Mine a repo's accumulated git stashes for content worth landing on the primary branch, then drop the rest. Use when a project has piled up stashes ("*N" in the prompt), "clean up my stashes", or a swarm of parallel agents has left dozens of WIP stashes behind.

Set up cloud consoles that block headless automation, then wire the resulting credentials into Supabase/Vault/Vercel/.env. Use when a console step cannot be scripted: "browser may not be secure", 2FA, CAPTCHA, OAuth consent screens, or a webhook signing secret with no reveal API (e.g., Stripe).

Run a large or parallelizable task across many agents. Use when a task is too big for one context, has many independent units (whole-codebase refactor / audit / migration / dead-code sweep), or you need multiple independent perspectives (adversarial verification).
